prediction.model: LightGBM on physics features + Sightglass rationale engine
prediction.rationale:
Cooler: close to total failure. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 53.0 °C (71% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 59.3 °C (53% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 57.7 °C (60% above healthy). Rapid temperature accumulation with minimal inlet-outlet drop indicates loss of cooling circulation.
Valve: close to total failure. Evidence: PS2 pressure rise time 9.71 s (5% above healthy); PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.76 s (within 1% of healthy). Substantial delay in circuit pressurization confirms delayed spool actuation in the main valve.
Pump leakage: weak leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 3.28 l/min (50% below healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 798 W·min/l (108% above healthy); SE system efficiency factor 29.8 % (49% below healthy). Minor drop in delivered flow relative to motor power indicates early internal pump leakage.
Accumulator: severely reduced. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 57.3 bar (23% above healthy). Dampening capacity is substantially impaired, producing high-frequency pressure oscillations across the circuit.

tslm_prediction.rationale:
Cooler: close to total failure. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 52.6 °C (70% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 58.9 °C (51% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 57.2 °C (59% above healthy). Elevated hydraulic oil temperature and reduced heat dissipation across the exchanger indicate severe cooler malfunction.
Valve: close to total failure. Evidence: PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.76 s (within 1% of healthy); PS2 pressure rise time 9.70 s (5% above healthy). Substantial delay in circuit pressurization confirms delayed spool actuation in the main valve.
Pump leakage: severe leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 3.23 l/min (50% below healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 804 W·min/l (110% above healthy); SE system efficiency factor 30.3 % (48% below healthy). High power-to-flow ratio demonstrates extensive internal leakage across the pump chambers.
Accumulator: close to total failure. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 57.3 bar (23% above healthy). Marked pressure ripple and reduced peak pressure indicate severe loss of hydraulic accumulator gas pre-charge.
